standaloneSentence.consequence: the standalone wording cannot carry a consolidated nil even if identical wording is later found in the consolidated notes; the consolidated occurrence would have to be read and quoted in its own right

result.threePeriodCheckReason: the qualifying period (FY2023-24 consolidated) was not retrieved, so there is no base against which to line up FY2022-23 and FY2021-22; retrieving later periods first would not cure the gap

constraintsHonoured: a standalone declaration was not transferred to consolidated data
no assumption was made that the standalone statement applies to subsidiaries or to the Group
no dash, absent caption, arithmetic reconciliation, auditor remark or aggregator rendering was promoted to a nil
no IPD writes, no production scope, no new persistence mechanism, no IX policy change

opened.title: Deep-page retrieval of large Indian issuer annual reports is capped by every available reader
opened.detail: The direct reader renders roughly the first 100 KB of a PDF's text (about 55 printed pages here) and stops; the text-rendering proxy that paginates whole documents is refused (HTTP 403) by the NSE archive. Absence of wording beyond the cap is therefore not evidence of absence, and no negative finding about the unrendered pages may be inferred from it.
